fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake Rex opens a question item and sees the asking session's tab focused, opens a sign-off item and sees the run's journalled tab focused, gets the run named with its tab gone once the fake Rex no longer has that tab, and gets exit 2 for an unknown item.
fields.statement: rhiza inbox open <item> focuses the Rex tab of the session that asked a question, or, for a sign-off, a failed run or a run the daemon gave up on, the run's tab as its journal records it, so the owner answers in the agent's own menu; a run whose tab is gone is named with its tab gone, and an unknown item exits 2.

fields.acceptance: With a fake Rex, rhiza daemon --once over a run that blocks on a question, one waiting at sign-off, one that failed and one the daemon gives up on sends exactly four notifications, one per item, and a second rhiza daemon --once with the same items sends none.
fields.statement: On each poll, rhiza daemon sends one Rex notification for each inbox item it has not notified yet, naming the change set and what waits (a question, a sign-off, a failed run or a run the daemon gave up on), and none again while the item stays; a run keeps its own blocked-run notice.

The inbox gets its own change set, The inbox, whose intent covers questions, sign-offs, failed and given-up runs, recommendations, opening each item and notifications. Every inbox node is carved into it from 01M5SWTKV6, which is withdrawn.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's option, picked by the owner: "New inbox change set (Recommended)" (open a new change set 'The inbox' whose intent covers questions, sign-offs, failed and given-up runs, and notifications; carve all the inbox nodes into it and withdraw 01M5SWTKV6, so the design stays in one piece)

fields.statement: inbox-notify depends on inbox-list, which defines what an inbox item is and when it stays, so its check runs against real items. The check stays as written.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's option, picked by the owner: "Add the needs (Recommended)" (daemon-status needs daemon-picks and daemon-run-tabs; inbox-notify needs inbox-list; the checks stay as strong as written)

fields.statement: The daemon sends inbox notifications: on each poll it finds inbox items it has not notified yet and sends one Rex notification per item, none again while the item stays. A run keeps its own blocked-run notice.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's option, picked by the owner: "The daemon (Recommended)" (on each poll the daemon notices new inbox items and sends one Rex notification per item, with no repeat while it stays; runs keep their own blocked notice; inbox-notify then needs the daemon)

fields.statement: inbox-open focuses the run's tab from the window and block the run's journal records (Decision journal-run-tab), and says the tab is gone when Rex no longer has it.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's option, picked by the owner: "Journal the run's tab (Recommended)" (when a run starts in Rex, its journal records its window and block, alongside run-process-record's host and pid, so inbox-open focuses that tab when it's still open, and otherwise says it's gone)

ops.note: the run's tab inbox-open focuses is the one this Decision journals
